SEC.-23, RAJ NAGAR, GHAZIABAD - 201 002.

IPC/1035/PvPI/2011-12 21st July 2011.

OFFICE ORDER

All recognized ADR monitoring centres are authorized to take a telephone connection and a broad band internet connection. The bills pertaining to this will be reimbursed by the National Coordination Centre. This order is issued to facilitate ADR reporting as agreed in the meeting on 21st July 2011, held at Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission.

(Dr. G. N. Singh)

Secretary-cum-Scientific Director

Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission
